verdict.rationale: Confirmed malicious attack with successful sensitive data access.

summary: During 2026-07-17 22:58:30 – 2026-07-17 22:58:32, a confirmed true-positive attack from 185.220.101.42 progressed through Initial Access, Credential Access, and Collection. Observable source events show device-code authentication, managed identity token retrieval via IMDS for Microsoft Graph, and repeated mailbox item access against victim@contoso.com.

representationNotes.commentary: Entity type 'Cloud App' was normalized to schema type 'application' because the schema has no dedicated cloud-app type.
The summary states 'Data access/exfiltration confirmed' but the detailed timeline explicitly shows mailbox item access only; no separate exfiltration event artifact is provided.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Allow explicit distinction between asserted impact statements and evidenced transfer events.

representationNotes.commentary: Four mailbox access events use four different AppIds, but the source does not explicitly link them to the managed identity, cloud app, or source IP beyond incident-level correlation.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Support incident-level correlation links with weaker provenance semantics.

representationNotes.commentary: Attack graph edge 'stole token from webapp-vm-001' was represented with relationship kind 'stole-token-from' from IP to VM; the schema cannot directly encode the exact graph phrasing plus token object in one relation.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Add first-class token/credential artifact entity and token theft relation.

representationNotes.commentary: Alerts IA-ALERT-003 through IA-ALERT-006 are each attached to all four mailbox access events because the source groups them together and does not map individual alerts to individual OfficeActivity records.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Support grouped alert-to-event correlation with unknown per-event mapping.
